caption: The drawing features a single object—a pressing iron—depicted in a three-quarter view. The iron's body is metallic and colored golden yellow with shading to indicate depth and wear, while the angled leading edge is slightly darker in tone. Two vertical supports, colored in a similar golden hue, rise from the front and back of the iron to hold the handle. The handle is cylindrical with a rounded shape and is colored in dark brown tones, resembling wood, with visible grain and shading to indicate its curvature. On the left side of the iron, there is a mechanical lever or latch with circular and elongated cutouts, rendered in a gold color with shadows to show its metallic quality. All of these elements are set against a plain, light-colored background. The drawing is labeled in pencil at the bottom as "Sketch – Pressing Iron – 1821," with the artist's signature visible in the lower right corner.
title: Pressing Iron
